title: Mistral JavaScript SDK 发布 0.3.0
description: API changes The field tool_call_id on the tool message will be mandatory in the future. It can be already added to improve the model performance when dealing with tool calls, especially multiple ones (#76). Breaking changes - TS only We added the tool_call_id mandatory type on tool messages. This has no impact on runtime but should be added to pass type checking (#76). Full Changelog: 0.2.0...0.3.0
